homebrewV2.preservedPayload: This content uses an unrecognized format. Its original fields are preserved.
homebrewV2.setupHelp: Add the specific rules fields to this saved draft.
homebrewV2.effectsHelp: Declare effects in order. These fields describe the content; they do not apply it.
homebrewV2.authoringOnly: Rules fields are checked for consistency. They do not roll dice, spend resources or execute effects.
homebrewV2.importHelp: Review the file before creating a new draft. Your existing creations stay separate.
homebrewV2.incompatible: This file cannot be edited in this format. The original is preserved for recovery.
homebrewV2.storageError: The browser could not preserve the file. Download the original before leaving.
homebrewV2.reuseHelp: Add this recorded version. Your character will keep its own state.
homebrewV2.statePreserved: The copy keeps its quantity, preparation and remaining uses.
homebrewV2.noInstances: No custom copies yet. Add a recorded creation from your library.
homebrewV2.unavailable: Cannot load this content. Try again when online.
homebrewV2.capacityMismatch: Remaining uses exceed the new capacity. Your recorded state has been preserved.

fields.repeatable: Can be acquired more than once

diagnostics.invalid-definition: An included definition cannot be read safely.
diagnostics.unsupported-family: This family is not supported here
diagnostics.instance-state: Keep instance state in the character copy
diagnostics.invalid-number: Enter a number within the allowed limits
diagnostics.invalid-boolean: Choose a valid yes or no value
diagnostics.invalid-formula: Use a constant or dice formula, such as 2d6+3
diagnostics.invalid-declarations: Unsupported declarations must be a list of text
diagnostics.invalid-effects: Use an ordered list of at most 32 effects
diagnostics.effect-formula: The effect needs a nonnegative formula
diagnostics.damage-type-unused: Clear the damage type for this effect
diagnostics.condition-unused: Clear the condition for this effect
diagnostics.condition-formula: A condition has no dice formula
diagnostics.duration-unused: This duration does not use a number
diagnostics.save-required: A save-gated effect requires saving throw resolution
diagnostics.attack-required: An on-hit effect requires attack resolution
diagnostics.area-required: Choose an area with a positive size
diagnostics.range-order: Long range cannot be shorter than normal range
diagnostics.range-unused: This range choice does not use a distance
diagnostics.dex-cap-policy: A Dexterity limit requires the capped policy
diagnostics.armor-category: Armor fields require the armor category
diagnostics.shield-category: A shield bonus requires the shield category
diagnostics.recovery-resource: Recovery requires capacity and a recovery boundary
diagnostics.recovery-capacity: Recovery can exceed the declared capacity
diagnostics.material-required: These fields require a material component
diagnostics.area-unused: Clear the size when there is no area
diagnostics.save-unused: Clear the unused saving throw ability
diagnostics.fixed-dc: A fixed DC requires a save and a positive value
diagnostics.scaling-dependency: Choose what the additional effect depends on
diagnostics.cantrip-slot-scaling: Cantrips do not scale with spell slots
diagnostics.passive-resource: A passive feature does not spend uses
diagnostics.prerequisite-level: The character has not reached the required level.
diagnostics.prerequisite-ability: The required ability score is not met.
diagnostics.prerequisite-unused: Clear prerequisite values that are not used
diagnostics.invalid-collection: This collection is incompatible or too large.
diagnostics.invalid-row: This declaration has an incompatible structure.
diagnostics.duplicate-id: Use a distinct ID for each declaration.
diagnostics.reaction-trigger: Choose the event that opens this reaction.
diagnostics.activation-kind: Activation must match the kind of action.
diagnostics.multiattack-steps: Declare the attacks in this sequence.
diagnostics.multiattack-effects: A multiattack uses its referenced actions, without its own effects.
diagnostics.legendary-cost: Declare the legendary resource and its cost.
diagnostics.missing-program: A referenced program is not included.
diagnostics.nested-multiattack: A multiattack cannot reference another multiattack.
diagnostics.invalid-recharge: Recharge requires start of turn and a d6 threshold from 1 to 6.
diagnostics.recharge-unused: A recharge threshold requires recharge recovery.
diagnostics.resource-unused: This declaration does not use a resource reference.
diagnostics.negative-set: A fixed value cannot be negative.
diagnostics.self-dependency: A rule cannot depend on or conflict with itself.
diagnostics.defense-target: Choose the damage type or condition for this defense.
diagnostics.hp-formula: Declare a hit point formula with a nonnegative minimum.
diagnostics.typed-declarations-required: Add at least one typed action or rule declaration.
diagnostics.multiattack-resource-capacity: The full multiattack costs more than the declared resource capacity.
diagnostics.resource-id: Use 1–128 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens for a resource ID.
diagnostics.ability-context: The base ability score is unavailable. Recover or complete the authorized character data first.
diagnostics.ability-maximum: This increase exceeds the ordinary ability maximum of 20.
diagnostics.background-distribution: Choose +2/+1 in two different allowed abilities, or +1 in all three.
diagnostics.background-feat-required: This background needs a recorded Origin feat. Update the library creation first.
diagnostics.background-tool-required: This background needs a tool proficiency. Update the library creation first.
diagnostics.character-mismatch: These choices belong to another character.
diagnostics.choice-answer: Choose the required number of available options.
diagnostics.duplicate-origin: Only one species and one background can be active. Replace the existing selection.
diagnostics.equipment-choice: Choose the equipment package or starting gold.
diagnostics.inactive-answer: A retained answer is currently inactive.
diagnostics.incompatible-origin-build: The origin build cannot be read safely. Recover its original before proceeding.
diagnostics.invalid-exception: This exception does not match a supported rule exception.
diagnostics.nonrepeatable-feat: This feat is already acquired and is not repeatable.
diagnostics.obsolete-answer: An answer refers to a choice no longer offered by this version.
diagnostics.prerequisite-any: None of the listed alternatives is satisfied.
diagnostics.prerequisite-feat: The required feat has not been acquired earlier in this build.
diagnostics.prerequisite-proficiency: The required proficiency cannot be established from earlier selections and known character facts.
diagnostics.prerequisite-spellcasting: A qualifying spellcasting grant cannot be established. Knowing a spell alone does not satisfy this requirement.
diagnostics.choice-cycle: Choices depend on each other in a cycle. Remove one dependency.
diagnostics.conflicting-dependency: Two included versions have conflicting source content.
diagnostics.dependency-cycle: Included creations form a circular dependency.
diagnostics.dependency-depth: The dependency chain is too deep. The supported maximum is eight.
diagnostics.dependency-identity: An included version does not match its recorded source.
diagnostics.duplicate-or-invalid-id: A choice or option has a duplicated or invalid internal reference. Restore the original or recreate that row.
diagnostics.empty-prerequisite: Add at least one requirement to this group.
diagnostics.incompatible-reference: The included creation has an incompatible content family.
diagnostics.invalid-benefit: A benefit has an incompatible structure. Its original is preserved.
diagnostics.invalid-choice: A choice has an incompatible structure. Its original is preserved.
diagnostics.invalid-count: The number to choose must fit the available options.
diagnostics.invalid-dependencies: The included bundle is malformed or exceeds 32 definitions.
diagnostics.invalid-dependency: An included source has incomplete version or provenance data.
diagnostics.invalid-option: An option has an incompatible structure. Its original is preserved.
diagnostics.invalid-parent: Select a valid earlier choice and its triggering option.
diagnostics.invalid-prerequisite: A requirement has an incompatible structure. Its original is preserved.
diagnostics.missing-parent: The earlier choice or triggering option is missing.
diagnostics.missing-reference: An included creation is missing. Include its recorded version from the library.
diagnostics.nested-dependencies: This bundle uses a nested format that must be recovered before use.
diagnostics.origin-feat-category: A background must include a feat in the Origin category.
diagnostics.unsupported-benefit: This benefit is preserved but is not yet modeled.
diagnostics.unsupported-predicate: This requirement is preserved but is not yet modeled.
diagnostics.unsupported-policy: This casting policy is preserved but is not supported.
diagnostics.prerequisite-mechanic-mismatch: The required feat reference does not match the included version. Choose it again by name.
diagnostics.ambiguous-feat-prerequisite: This unqualified custom feat reference is ambiguous. Choose a recorded feat by name.
diagnostics.casting-ability: Choose a casting ability for this spellcasting policy.
diagnostics.duplicate-program-binding: A program is already granted at an earlier level.
diagnostics.incompatible-class-field: This field belongs to a subclass, not a class.
diagnostics.incompatible-subclass-field: This field belongs to a class, not a subclass.
diagnostics.incompatible-pact-slots: Pact Magic slots require a Pact Magic policy.
diagnostics.incompatible-spell-slots: Ordinary spell slots do not match this casting policy.
diagnostics.incompatible-parent-class: Select a recorded class as the subclass parent.
diagnostics.inherited-casting-contribution: Inherited spellcasting must not add another slot contribution.
diagnostics.invalid-abilities: Choose distinct valid abilities. Starting classes have two saving throw proficiencies.
diagnostics.invalid-hit-die: Choose a d6, d8, d10 or d12 Hit Die.
diagnostics.invalid-multiclass-contribution: Check the multiclass divisor and rounding policy.
diagnostics.invalid-parent-class: The subclass needs a pinned parent class and its matching identity.
diagnostics.invalid-progression: Use distinct increasing levels from 1 to 20, beginning at the acquisition level.
diagnostics.invalid-resource-binding: Choose an existing resource and a capacity within its declared limit.
diagnostics.invalid-spellcasting: Check the spellcasting declaration and level counts.
diagnostics.invalid-subclass-schedule: Subclass feature levels must be distinct and increasing.
diagnostics.noncasting-progression: This level grants spells without a spellcasting policy.
diagnostics.noncasting-parent-augmentation: This parent class does not cast spells. Define a separate spellcasting policy for the subclass instead of adding spells to the parent policy.
diagnostics.parent-version-mismatch: The selected class does not match the pinned parent version.
diagnostics.program-unavailable: A referenced program is not available at this level.
diagnostics.resource-unavailable: A program costs more than the resources available at this level.
diagnostics.unsupported-level-basis: This level basis is preserved but not supported.
diagnostics.invalid-acquisition: The acquisition declaration is incomplete or malformed.
diagnostics.subclass-schedule: The subclass feature does not match the parent schedule.
diagnostics.parent-mechanic-mismatch: The parent identity differs from its recorded class.

homebrewV2.instanceConflict: This copy changed elsewhere. Compare the saved state with your draft before saving again.
homebrewV2.noMatchingCopies: No copies of this creation on this character.
homebrewV2.stateConflict: This copy changed while you were editing. Review the saved state before saving your draft.
homebrewV2.recoveryUnavailable: Could not preserve this draft locally. Download it before leaving.
homebrewV2.quantityRequired: Enter a whole quantity of zero or more.
homebrewV2.unsupportedHelp: One limitation per line. These declarations are preserved without automatic interpretation.
homebrewV2.preparationHelp: Choose copies and rules for your campaign. Combat resolution is not available here.
homebrewV2.chooseCampaignFirst: Select a campaign in the library first.
homebrewV2.preparationFailed: Could not complete this operation. Your saved data remains available.
homebrewV2.noPreparedCopies: Reuse a recorded version from your library to add it here.
homebrewV2.copyConflict: This copy changed. Compare your edits before saving.
homebrewV2.removeCopyHelp: Only this campaign copy will be removed. Library versions and other copies are preserved.
homebrewV2.ruleDependencyHelp: These active declarations require a missing rule, conflict with another rule, or replace the same rule at equal priority. Review the choice before play.
homebrewV2.removeCreationHelp: Remove this creation from your library. Recorded versions, granted copies and the original in the operation receipt are retained. Existing offers are revoked separately.
homebrewV2.bestiaryHelp: Stable creature versions, ready to prepare for your campaign.
homebrewV2.bestiaryEmpty: No matching creatures. Record a stable version in Creations to add it here.

origin.choicesHelp: Give each choice a clear name and its available options. A later choice can depend on an earlier option. Changing the parent preserves the options for you to reconcile.
origin.benefitsHelp: These benefits apply when this origin or option is selected. Add named choices below for benefits the player must choose.
origin.requirementsHelp: All requirements below must be met. Use “Any of these” for alternatives. The character picker explains unmet requirements and offers an explicit exception.
origin.dependenciesHelp: Choose a recorded version to include. Its rules and dependent choices are frozen with this creation. Sharing carries the complete bundle; later edits never change it silently.
origin.sourceError: This version could not be included. Refresh the library and check the content size or conflicting dependencies. Your draft is preserved.
origin.backgroundHelp: The character chooses +2 and +1 in two different listed abilities, or +1 in all three. The ordinary maximum is 20. Select one recorded Origin feat below.
origin.equipmentHelp: Include equipment from the library, then select the items in this background’s starting package. The character chooses the package or the listed gold entitlement; no inventory quantities or balance are created here.
origin.advancedHelp: Declare the same mechanics used by other creations. These fields prepare automation in the shared engine; the editor does not execute combat.
origin.buildHelp: These recorded choices are part of this character’s current build. Each keeps its source version; editing a library template does not change it.
origin.unavailableBuild: Current origins could not be read. Refresh your access or recover the original data below. Imported origins are not shown as current while this is unresolved.
origin.noSelections: No new origins selected. The imported baseline is still in use. Choose a recorded species, feat or background from the library to add it.
origin.editBuildHelp: Choose the benefits, review requirements and confirm the change for this character. Your local draft is kept until the write is confirmed.
origin.restoredDraft: Your saved local draft has been restored, including its original comparison base.
origin.versionHelp: Updating this selection preserves answers and retains previous exceptions as inactive history. Review changed rules and confirm any new exception. Other copies and the library stay independent.
origin.versionUnavailable: The source versions are unavailable. You can still manage this saved copy and its choices.
origin.removalHelp: This removes only this selection and its contributions. Removing a replacement species or background restores its imported baseline. Other selections remain and must still meet their requirements.
origin.confirmHelp: Confirm writes one change to this character’s build, with its source and receipt. Retained inactive answers have no effect. The library template and other characters do not change.
origin.conflictHelp: Your draft keeps the values you started from. Review the latest saved build before applying your choice; nothing is overwritten automatically.
origin.saveError: The change could not be confirmed. Your draft is preserved. Check access and local storage, then review or retry the pending receipt.
origin.reuseHelp: Choose the character first. Next you will review choices, requirements and the consequences before confirming.
origin.retainedHelp: This answer is retained but currently contributes nothing. Returning to its earlier choice can restore it. Keep it for later or discard it explicitly.
origin.exceptionHelp: Record why this character may make this choice despite the stated rule. This is an explicit character exception; it does not change the template, permissions or unsupported mechanics.
origin.importedBaseline: Imported baseline: superseded or unresolved facts
origin.baselineHelp: These imported values are kept for recovery and comparison. Superseded or unattributed origin facts do not certify the current build.
origin.missingAbilityHelp: Some base ability scores are unavailable. They remain unknown; no score has been invented.
origin.customProficiencyHelp: For a table-specific proficiency, use one stable reference shared by its grant and requirements (for example, guild-cartography). It is not translated or matched from prose. Standard tools and languages should use the named choices above.
origin.differentDraft: A different change is already in progress
origin.switchHelp: Continue the saved draft, or keep it aside and start the change you requested. Kept drafts remain available below.
origin.startRequested: Keep draft and start requested change
origin.sourceIdentityHelp: These advanced references identify the source and the same mechanic across versions and copies. Keep them stable when revising a creation; ordinary choices use the named controls.

baselineStatus.unresolved: Imported facts with an unconfirmed source

origin.historicalException: Previous source exception: kept for reference, not applied. Record a new exception if this version still needs one.
origin.alreadySaved: These choices already match the saved build. Confirm to finish this review.
origin.backgroundChoiceHelp: Choose +2 and +1 in two different listed abilities, or +1 in all three. The ordinary maximum is 20. The Origin feat included in this background is shown below.
origin.equipmentChoiceHelp: Choose this background’s equipment package or its starting gold. This records your entitlement; adding items and gold to your inventory is a separate step.

classes.levelHelp: Levels refer to this class. Resource capacities replace the previous value; unchanged resources carry forward. These declarations do not change a character.
classes.importHelp: Import JSON to add class or subclass mechanics. You can review their levels and dependencies in Preview; editing the name or description preserves the mechanics.
classes.noSeparateCasting: No separate policy; follow the parent relationship above
classes.composedCastingHelp: These combined declarations apply once to this class. Omitted levels keep the previous totals; Pact Magic remains separate from ordinary multiclass spell slots.
classes.compositionUnavailable: Combined casting is unavailable until the preserved declarations are compatible.

classEditor.identityHelp: Edit the library template. Existing character copies and recorded versions keep their own content.
classEditor.subclassHelp: Choose the class levels that grant subclass features. The subclass editor is a separate step.
classEditor.commonHelp: Include recorded library versions here, then select their names in any acquisition or level. These common declarations belong to both entry paths.
classEditor.startingHelp: Benefits and choices gained when this is the first class. The two saving throw proficiencies above belong only to this entry.
classEditor.multiclassHelp: Requirements, benefits and choices when adding this class after another class. This edits the template, without changing a character.
classEditor.castingHelp: Declare the casting policy here and the absolute spell counts at each level below. Changing a policy preserves the existing level table for your review.
classEditor.contributionHelp: Explicit contribution to ordinary multiclass slots. None and Pact Magic do not contribute. Divisor and rounding are authored rules, not automatic RAW certification.
classEditor.programHelp: Choose actions defined in Advanced mechanics below. Grant each action once; its costs must be affordable from this level onward.
classEditor.noPrograms: Define actions in Advanced mechanics, then select them here by name.
classEditor.capacityHelp: A binding makes a resource available and sets its total capacity, replacing the previous capacity. Omitted resources keep their previous capacity. This does not refill remaining uses.
classEditor.noResources: Define resources in Advanced mechanics, then set their capacity here.
classEditor.countsHelp: Absolute totals for this level, including zero. Ordinary slot fields run from spell level 1 to 9; Pact Magic has its own fields. Omitted class levels retain the preceding row.
classEditor.identityNote: Generated once. Renaming or changing the level preserves this reference and its choices.
classEditor.reuseHelp: Create an independent library draft from the last recorded version. Duplicate copies the current draft. Character class selection belongs to character creation and advancement.
classEditor.requirementsHelp: All requirements below must be met. Level requirements refer to this class. Use “Any of these” for alternatives.
classEditor.benefitsHelp: These benefits are declared for this acquisition or class level. Add choices for benefits the player must select. This does not change a character.

subclassEditor.parentHelp: Choose a recorded class. Its exact version is kept with this subclass, including any required creations. Changing the parent keeps your existing levels and choices for review.
subclassEditor.noParent: Choose the parent class before recording a version. Create and record the class in your library first if it is missing.
subclassEditor.scheduleHelp: The first row must match the first level shown. Features, choices, actions and resources belong to these levels; spellcasting-only rows may fall between them.
subclassEditor.relationshipHelp: Inherit keeps the parent unchanged. Augment adds cantrips and spells while retaining the parent’s slots. Replace supplies one casting policy for this class, including its multiclass contribution. Existing values are kept for review.
subclassEditor.castingHelp: Declare only this subclass’s casting. Inherit and Augment use no local slot or multiclass contribution; Replace supplies the policy for this class. The reader shows the combined declarations.
subclassEditor.commonHelp: These declarations belong to this subclass. Use the level rows below for features acquired at scheduled class levels.
subclassEditor.parentError: This parent cannot be included. Review its recorded rules and the preserved dependency data, then choose a compatible version.
